skill_name: Compare and contrast the effects of a production-driven economy and a service-driven economy
workflow: A production-driven economy is based on the production and manufacture of physical goods which are then distributed to consumers. This type of economy is characterized by its extensive use of physical capital and production methods. The production-driven economy is focused on tangible goods and making profits from the sale of these goods.
